en: A colored illustration of a large neoclassical building with a prominent golden dome, surrounded by trees and landscaped grounds. The building is shown from an elevated viewpoint, with a broad staircase and arched entrances at the front. The skyline and long avenues of a city are visible in the background. At the top margin of the image, printed text reads "LIBRARY OF CONGRESS, WASHINGTON, D. C."
